name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti; 400 g minced beef; 1 onion; 2 cloves garlic; 1 carrot; 800 g chopped tomatoes; 2 tbsp tomato paste; 50 g parmesan
steps: Finely dice the onion, garlic and carrot. | Brown the beef, add the vegetables and tomato paste and fry briefly. | Add the tomatoes, season and simmer gently for 30 minutes. | Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and parmesan.

name: Pesto Pasta with Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 500 g fusilli; 500 g cherry tomatoes; 1 jar basil pesto; 50 g parmesan; 30 g pine nuts
steps: Roast the tomatoes with oil and salt at 200 °C for 15 minutes. | Cook the pasta and toss with pesto and a splash of pasta water. | Top with the tomatoes, parmesan and toasted pine nuts.

name: Mushroom Risotto
ingredients: 320 g risotto rice; 400 g mushrooms; 1 onion; 1 l vegetable stock; 100 ml white wine; 60 g parmesan; 30 g butter
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms until golden and set aside. | Soften the onion, add the rice and toast for a minute, then add the wine. | Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes. | Stir in the mushrooms, butter and parmesan.

name: Beef Lasagne
ingredients: 250 g lasagne sheets; 500 g minced beef; 800 g chopped tomatoes; 1 onion; 500 ml milk; 40 g butter; 40 g flour; 150 g grated mozzarella
steps: Make a meat sauce with the beef, onion and tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes. | Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick (béchamel). | Layer sauce, sheets and béchamel in a dish, finish with cheese. | Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti; 6 cloves garlic; 6 tbsp olive oil; 1 tsp chili flakes; 1 bunch parsley
steps: Cook the spaghetti. | Gently fry thinly sliced garlic and chili in the oil until just golden. | Toss the pasta with the oil, a splash of pasta water and chopped parsley.

name: Minestrone
ingredients: 1 onion; 2 carrots; 2 celery sticks; 1 zucchini; 1 can white beans; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 1.2 l vegetable stock; 100 g small pasta
steps: Dice all the vegetables and soften them in olive oil. | Add tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes. | Add beans and pasta and cook for 10 more minutes.

name: Margherita Pizza
ingredients: 2 packs pizza dough; 400 g passata; 250 g mozzarella; 1 bunch basil; 2 tbsp olive oil
steps: Heat the oven as hot as it goes (at least 230 °C). | Roll out the dough, spread with seasoned passata and torn mozzarella. | Bake for 10–12 minutes and top with basil and a drizzle of oil.

name: Lentil Bolognese
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti; 200 g red lentils; 1 onion; 1 carrot; 2 cloves garlic; 800 g chopped tomatoes; 2 tbsp tomato paste
steps: Soften the diced onion, carrot and garlic. | Add lentils, tomatoes, tomato paste and 300 ml water. | Simmer for 20 minutes until thick and serve with the spaghetti.

name: Tuna Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 500 g penne; 2 cans tuna; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 1 onion; 2 tbsp capers; 1 lemon
steps: Cook the penne. | Soften the onion, add tomatoes and capers and simmer for 8 minutes. | Stir in the drained tuna and lemon zest and toss with the pasta.

name: Red Lentil Dal with Rice
ingredients: 300 g red lentils; 300 g basmati rice; 400 ml coconut milk; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 1 onion; 1 piece ginger (thumb-sized); 2 tsp curry powder; 100 g baby spinach
steps: Soften the onion and ginger, add the curry powder briefly. | Add lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 400 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes. | Cook the rice at the same time. | Stir in the spinach and season with salt and lemon.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast; 150 g plain yogurt; 2 tbsp tikka masala paste; 1 onion; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 150 ml cream; 300 g basmati rice
steps: Mix the diced chicken with yogurt and half the paste and leave for 10 minutes. | Brown the chicken in a hot pan, set aside. | Soften the onion with the rest of the paste, add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. | Add the chicken and cream, cook for 5 more minutes and serve with rice.

name: Chana Masala
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 1 onion; 2 cloves garlic; 1 piece ginger (thumb-sized); 2 tsp garam masala; 1 tsp cumin; 300 g basmati rice
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger until soft. | Add the spices for a minute, then tomatoes and chickpeas. | Simmer for 15 minutes and serve with rice.

name: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 500 g frozen spinach; 250 g paneer; 1 onion; 2 cloves garlic; 2 tsp garam masala; 100 ml cream; 4 naan breads
steps: Brown the cubed paneer and set aside. | Soften the onion and garlic, add the spinach and spices and cook for 10 minutes. | Blend roughly, stir in cream and paneer, serve with naan.

name: Vegetable Coconut Curry
ingredients: 400 ml coconut milk; 2 tbsp red curry paste; 1 head broccoli; 2 carrots; 1 bell pepper; 200 g tofu; 300 g jasmine rice
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little oil and pour in the coconut milk. | Cook the vegetables and cubed tofu in it for 12 minutes. | Season with soy sauce and lime and serve with rice.

name: Vegetable Fried Noodles
ingredients: 400 g egg-free noodles; 2 carrots; 1 bell pepper; 200 g pak choi; 4 tbsp soy sauce; 1 piece ginger (thumb-sized)
steps: Cook the noodles as on the pack and rinse cold. | Stir-fry the vegetables in strips in a very hot wok. | Add noodles, ginger and soy sauce and toss briefly.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh; 3 tbsp green curry paste; 400 ml coconut milk; 200 g green beans; 1 bell pepper; 1 tbsp fish sauce; 300 g jasmine rice
steps: Fry the curry paste, add the sliced chicken and brown. | Pour in the coconut milk, add vegetables and simmer for 12 minutes. | Season with fish sauce and lime, serve with rice.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
ingredients: 400 g firm tofu; 300 g sushi rice; 6 tbsp teriyaki sauce; 1 head broccoli; 2 carrots; 2 tbsp sesame seeds
steps: Cook the rice. | Fry the cubed tofu until crisp, then glaze with teriyaki sauce. | Steam the broccoli and grate the carrots. | Serve everything in bowls topped with sesame.

name: Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: 300 g cooked rice (from yesterday); 4 eggs; 200 g frozen peas; 1 bunch spring onions; 3 tbsp soy sauce
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside. | Fry the cold rice with peas and spring onions until hot. | Add the eggs and soy sauce and toss.

name: Quick Miso Ramen
ingredients: 4 portions ramen noodles; 4 tbsp miso paste; 1.5 l vegetable stock; 4 eggs; 200 g mushrooms; 200 g pak choi; 1 bunch spring onions
steps: Boil the eggs for 6½ minutes and cool in cold water. | Heat the stock, stir in the miso, add mushrooms and pak choi. | Cook the noodles, divide into bowls, pour over the broth, add halved eggs and spring onions.

name: Chili sin Carne
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans; 1 can sweetcorn; 800 g chopped tomatoes; 1 bell pepper; 1 onion; 2 tsp cumin; 1 tsp chili flakes; 250 g rice
steps: Dice and fry the onion and pepper, add the spices briefly. | Add tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer for 25 minutes. | Serve with rice.

name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 500 g minced beef; 8 small tortillas; 1 pack taco seasoning; 1 head iceberg lettuce; 2 tomatoes; 150 g grated cheddar; 150 g sour cream
steps: Brown the beef and stir in the seasoning with a splash of water. | Shred the lettuce and dice the tomatoes. | Warm the tortillas and let everyone fill their own.

name: Black Bean Burritos
ingredients: 4 large tortillas; 2 cans black beans; 200 g rice; 1 can sweetcorn; 1 avocado; 100 g grated cheddar; 1 jar salsa
steps: Cook the rice. | Warm the beans with cumin and a little salsa. | Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, corn, avocado and cheese and roll up.

name: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast; 3 bell peppers; 2 onions; 8 small tortillas; 1 pack fajita seasoning; 1 lime
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onions into strips. | Fry the chicken with the seasoning, then add the vegetables until just soft. | Squeeze over lime and serve in warm tortillas.

name: Cheese and Bean Quesadillas
ingredients: 8 small tortillas; 1 can kidney beans; 200 g grated cheddar; 1 bell pepper; 1 jar salsa
steps: Mash the beans roughly and dice the pepper. | Spread beans, pepper and cheese on half the tortillas and cover with the rest. | Fry each one for 2 minutes per side and cut into wedges. Serve with salsa.

name: Shakshuka
ingredients: 8 eggs; 800 g chopped tomatoes; 2 bell peppers; 1 onion; 1 tsp paprika; 1 tsp cumin; 1 flatbread
steps: Soften the onion and peppers, add the spices. | Add the tomatoes and reduce for 10 minutes. | Make hollows, crack in the eggs and cover until set. Serve with bread.

name: Falafel Bowl with Hummus
ingredients: 1 pack falafel mix; 200 g hummus; 200 g bulgur; 1 cucumber; 250 g cherry tomatoes; 1 bunch parsley
steps: Prepare and fry the falafel as on the pack. | Soak the bulgur in hot water. | Chop the vegetables and arrange everything in bowls with hummus.

name: Mujadara (Lentils, Rice and Crispy Onions)
ingredients: 200 g brown lentils; 200 g basmati rice; 4 onions; 2 tsp cumin; 6 tbsp olive oil; 200 g plain soy yogurt
steps: Cook the lentils for 15 minutes, then add the rice and cumin and cook until done. | Meanwhile fry the sliced onions slowly in oil until dark and crisp. | Serve the lentil rice topped with onions and yogurt.

name: Couscous Salad with Halloumi
ingredients: 250 g couscous; 250 g halloumi; 1 cucumber; 250 g cherry tomatoes; 1 bunch mint; 1 lemon
steps: Pour boiling stock over the couscous and leave covered for 5 minutes. | Chop the vegetables and herbs and mix in with lemon and oil. | Fry the sliced halloumi until golden and lay on top.

name: Cheese Spätzle (Käsespätzle)
ingredients: 800 g fresh spätzle; 250 g mountain cheese; 3 onions; 30 g butter; 1 head lettuce
steps: Fry the onion rings slowly in butter until golden. | Heat the spätzle and layer with grated cheese in a dish. | Melt briefly in the oven, top with the onions, serve with salad.

name: Pumpkin Ginger Soup
ingredients: 1 hokkaido pumpkin; 1 onion; 1 piece ginger (thumb-sized); 400 ml coconut milk; 600 ml vegetable stock; 1 baguette
steps: Deseed the pumpkin and dice it with the skin on. | Soften with onion and ginger, add the stock and boil for 20 minutes. | Add the coconut milk, blend until smooth and serve with baguette.

name: Potato Goulash
ingredients: 1 kg potatoes; 2 onions; 2 bell peppers; 2 tbsp sweet paprika; 2 tbsp tomato paste; 1 l vegetable stock
steps: Fry the onions, stir in paprika and tomato paste. | Add the diced potatoes, peppers and stock. | Simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the sauce thickens.

name: Schnitzel with Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 pork escalopes; 2 eggs; 100 g breadcrumbs; 50 g flour; 1 kg waxy potatoes; 250 ml vegetable stock; 1 onion; 3 tbsp vinegar; 1 lemon
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice. | Pour over warm stock with diced onion, vinegar and oil and leave to soak. | Flatten the meat, coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry until golden. Serve with lemon.

name: Potato Pancakes with Applesauce
ingredients: 1 kg floury potatoes; 1 onion; 2 eggs; 3 tbsp flour; 1 jar applesauce
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out the liquid. | Mix with eggs, flour and salt. | Fry spoonfuls flat in plenty of oil until crisp on both sides. Serve with applesauce.

name: Roast Vegetables with Feta
ingredients: 600 g potatoes; 2 bell peppers; 1 zucchini; 2 red onions; 200 g feta; 4 tbsp olive oil; 1 tsp rosemary
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (fan). | Cut the vegetables into wedges and toss with oil, salt and rosemary. | Roast for 30 minutes, crumble over the feta and bake for 5 more minutes.

name: Chicken and Rice Skillet
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast; 300 g rice; 1 bell pepper; 200 g frozen peas; 1 onion; 600 ml chicken stock; 1 tsp paprika
steps: Dice and brown the chicken, set aside. | Fry the onion and pepper, add the rice briefly. | Pour in the stock, cook for 15 minutes, stir in the peas and chicken.

name: Baked Salmon with Potatoes
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets; 800 g baby potatoes; 300 g green beans; 1 lemon; 1 bunch dill
steps: Halve the potatoes and roast at 200 °C for 15 minutes. | Add salmon and beans to the tray and drizzle with lemon and oil. | Bake for 12 more minutes and serve with dill.

name: Greek Salad with Pita
ingredients: 4 tomatoes; 1 cucumber; 1 red onion; 200 g feta; 100 g black olives; 4 pita breads
steps: Cut the tomatoes, cucumber and onion into chunks. | Add olives and a slab of feta, dress with oil, oregano and salt. | Serve with warm pita.

name: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers; 300 g minced beef; 150 g rice; 400 g passata; 1 onion; 100 g grated cheese
steps: Cook the rice for 10 minutes. | Fry the beef and onion, mix with the rice and half the passata. | Fill the halved peppers, pour the rest of the passata around, top with cheese and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes.

name: Prawn Paella
ingredients: 300 g paella rice; 300 g prawns; 1 onion; 1 bell pepper; 200 g frozen peas; 1 l fish or vegetable stock; 1 pinch saffron; 1 lemon
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in a wide pan, add the rice. | Add the stock and saffron and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes. | Press the prawns and peas into the rice and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve with lemon.

name: Tarte Flambée
ingredients: 2 packs tarte flambée dough; 200 g crème fraîche; 150 g bacon lardons; 2 red onions; 1 bunch chives
steps: Heat the oven to 230 °C. | Spread the dough with seasoned crème fraîche, scatter over onion rings and bacon. | Bake for 10–12 minutes and sprinkle with chives.

name: Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 eggplant; 2 zucchini; 2 bell peppers; 1 onion; 2 cloves garlic; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 1 tsp herbes de provence; 1 baguette
steps: Dice all the vegetables. | Fry the eggplant first, then add the onion, garlic, zucchini and peppers. | Add tomatoes and herbs and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Serve with baguette.

name: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 1 pack shortcrust pastry; 200 g bacon lardons; 4 eggs; 200 ml cream; 100 g grated cheese; 1 head lettuce
steps: Line a tin with the pastry and bake blind at 190 °C for 10 minutes. | Fry the bacon and scatter it over the base. | Whisk eggs, cream and cheese, pour over and bake for 30 minutes. Serve with salad.

name: Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 400 g macaroni; 40 g butter; 40 g flour; 600 ml milk; 200 g grated cheddar; 1 tsp mustard
steps: Cook the macaroni. | Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick. | Stir in the cheese and mustard, mix with the pasta and grill briefly if you like.

name: Homemade Burgers with Wedges
ingredients: 500 g minced beef; 4 sesame burger buns; 4 slices cheddar; 1 kg potatoes; 2 tomatoes; 1 head lettuce
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes. | Shape 4 patties, season and fry for 3–4 minutes per side, adding the cheese at the end. | Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce and tomato.

name: Sweet Potato Peanut Stew
ingredients: 800 g sweet potatoes; 1 onion; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 4 tbsp peanut butter; 800 ml vegetable stock; 1 can chickpeas; 100 g baby spinach; 250 g rice
steps: Soften the onion, add the diced sweet potato, tomatoes and stock. | Stir in the peanut butter and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes. | Fold in the spinach and serve with rice.
